figure.caption: Four cohorts from the chapter: each joins at one shared event, within one defined period, and is followed forward.

items.title: Birth cohort
items.text: Everyone born in the same period, usually one year.

items.title: Exposure cohort
items.text: People exposed to one drug, vaccine or infection within a defined period.

items.title: Marriage cohort
items.text: Men or women married on the same day or within one period.

items.title: Post-heart-attack
items.text: Everyone who survived a myocardial infarction (a heart attack) in one particular year.
